description: This file defines a CartProvider class that manages a shopping cart, including adding, removing, and clearing items. It uses ChangeNotifier for state management within a Flutter app.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A provider class managing cart items, with methods to add, remove, and clear items, notifying listeners of changes.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a menu item with customizations to the cart, including portion, quantity, spice, and add-ons, and notifies listeners.

methods.name: removeAt
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart at the specified index and notifies listeners.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart and notifies listeners.
